verdict.rationale: Vestd's own docs say UK companies issuing options to US taxpayers can get a 409A valuation from Vestd for a small fee, and there is a dedicated share valuation page, so the core ordering capability exists as a first-party service. None of the evidence shows the valuation is ordered inside the platform, generated from live cap table data, audit-ready, or refreshed on a schedule. Missing for 10: evidence of in-platform ordering, generation from live cap table data, audit-ready or defensibility documentation, scheduled refreshes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
